item.title: Concert Porter: The Agents Did Most of This One
item.description: My agents built a tool that carries a Concert Archives history into What I've Heard while I was on a phone call. My whole contribution was four requests.

item.title: A Weekend MCP-AQL Adapter for MakerPerks
item.description: My friend Nate Aune built MakerPerks, a directory of builder perks. I built an MCP-AQL adapter for it so my agents can query it directly instead of walking through a web interface.

item.title: Orbital Lifeboats: Napkin Math for Space Rescue
item.description: A side-quest exploring whether you could pre-position emergency rescue caches across the solar system, and the orbital mechanics that make it weird.
